events.description: A sudden, intense flash of orange-yellow fire and rapidly expanding blast wave erupts from the right side of the road near a building, characteristic of a high-order explosion.

Following the initial blast, a large plume of dense smoke and debris rises and expands, with visible fragmentation (e.g., a dark object airborne at ~2.5–3.0 s), indicating the aftermath and secondary effects of the explosion.

A large, sudden blast occurs in the mid-ground, producing a rapidly expanding cloud of dark smoke and dust that obscures the background; the shockwave is implied by the violent displacement of debris and dust.

Armed personnel in tactical gear are positioned near military vehicles amid heavy smoke and dust following an explosion; the scene suggests ongoing violent unrest or armed confrontation, with no clear indication of peaceful activity.

A large, sustained dust and smoke plume erupts and expands rapidly from the center-right of the frame, consistent with a powerful explosion occurring near or behind the building structure. The plume grows in volume and obscures the background over time, with no visible fireball but strong evidence of a blast-induced displacement of debris and air.

A large dust/debris cloud rapidly expands from the right side of the frame, engulfing a white vehicle and nearby structures, consistent with a near-instantaneous blast event. The cloud grows in volume and obscures the scene progressively across frames, with no visible fire but strong evidence of a sudden pressure wave and displacement of material.

A white van or bus on the right is violently displaced—tilting and rotating—amid the expanding dust cloud, indicating it was struck or thrown by the blast. Its position changes significantly across frames (e.g., upright at f0 to heavily tilted by f10), suggesting impact-induced motion rather than static damage.

A large dust/debris cloud rapidly expands from the right side of the frame, obscuring a white vehicle and nearby structure, consistent with a near-instantaneous blast event. The cloud continues to expand and settle over the interval, with no visible fireball but strong evidence of a sudden high-energy release.

A large, sustained dust/debris cloud erupts and expands rapidly from the right side of the frame, obscuring a building and a white vehicle; the cloud's sudden onset, vertical rise, and dense particulate nature are consistent with a near-instantaneous explosive event (e.g., IED or munition detonation), not a fire or collapse alone.

A large, sustained dust/debris cloud erupts and expands rapidly from the right side of the frame, consistent with a near-instantaneous explosion (e.g., IED or munition) occurring just off-screen or at the building edge. The cloud rises vertically and spreads outward over ~7.5 seconds, obscuring the background and indicating a powerful blast event.

A large, sustained dust/debris cloud erupts and expands rapidly from the right side of the frame near a building, consistent with a powerful explosion or blast event. The cloud rises vertically and spreads outward over multiple seconds, obscuring the background and indicating a sudden release of energy.

A large dust/debris cloud rapidly expands from the right side of the frame, originating near a building and vehicle, consistent with a sudden blast event. The cloud grows in volume and obscures the scene over the sequence, with no visible fire but strong evidence of a high-energy release.
